jobs.title: Case Manager, RN
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth PACE helps seniors stay in their homes and communities by providing comprehensive medical care and community\-based services. We serve the most vulnerable seniors with better quality and compassion in a value\-based model.



The Case Manager, RN directly guides participant care as a crucial voice on the interdisciplinary team (IDT). Reporting to clinical leadership, the Case Manager, RN delivers and oversees all aspects of care, including conducting required PACE assessments, developing and following personalized participant care plans, and supporting transitions of care coordination.


**This role is different because Case Manager, RNs at WelbeHealth:**


* Work a consistent Monday through Friday schedule – no weekends and no on call
* Build relationships with participants rather than providing short\-term care
* Career growth opportunities


**We care about our team members. That's why we offer:**


* Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Work/life balance \- We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
* 401K savings \+ match
* Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
* And additional benefits!


**On the day\-to\-day, you will:**


* Conduct clinic nursing assessments to determine participant needs, preferences, and goals, and actively participate in IDT meetings to develop participant care plans
* Deliver and document nursing interventions as agreed upon in participants' care plans, including but not limited to maintaining a safe environment, promptly responding to physician orders, and correctly administering medications
* Collaborate with the WelbeHealth PACE Physician and other members of the IDT in coordinating participant care needs, as well as communicate with participants and their families to revise care plans
* Instruct participants, their families, and caregivers regarding the disease process, self\-care techniques, and prevention strategies


**Job requirements include:**


* Graduate of an accredited school of nursing; Bachelor of Science (BSN) preferred
* Unencumbered California RN License
* Current Basic Life Support (BLS)/First Aide Certification required
* Two (2\) years of nursing experience in a clinical setting with a frail or elderly population preferred
* Must obtain CPR and First Aid certification within 180 days of hire and maintain certification thereafter; CPR and First Aid certification upon hire preferred


We are seeking Case Manager, RNs that ideally have experience working with a frail and elderly population. If you're ready to join a holistic care team that values both its patients and its providers, we'd love to hear from you!

**COVID\-19 Vaccination Policy**



At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

  


**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**



At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at WelbeHealth are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

  


**Beware of Scams**



Please ensure your application is being submitted through a WelbeHealth sponsored site only. Our emails will come from @welbehealth.com email addresses. You will never be asked to purchase your own employment equipment. You can report suspected scam activity to fraud.report@welbehealth.com

We believe taking care of our team is just as important as taking care of our patients.

* Full health benefits

jobs.title: ECM Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a compassionate and organized **ECM Care Coordinator** to support individuals enrolled in Enhanced Care Management (ECM). This role coordinates care, conducts member outreach and follow\-up, schedules services, maintains accurate documentation, and connects members with healthcare and community resources. The ideal candidate is dependable, detail\-oriented, and committed to helping individuals overcome barriers to care.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day **Enhanced Care Management (ECM)** services and support member engagement throughout the care management process.
* Conduct member outreach, enrollment support, follow\-ups, and ongoing communication to promote participation in ECM services.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, referrals, follow\-up services, and care\-related activities.
* Assist members with navigating medical, behavioral health, social service, and community\-based resources.
* Coordinate with healthcare providers, care teams, community organizations, and other service partners to support continuity of care.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of member outreach, referrals, care coordination activities, services, and follow\-up efforts.
* Track member eligibility, enrollment, authorizations, referrals, and service activity to ensure appropriate and timely follow\-up.
* Support ECM claims, encounters, billing documentation, and required reporting, including identifying and resolving missing or incomplete information.
* Maintain accurate member information within electronic health records, care management platforms, health plan portals, and internal tracking systems.
* Assist with obtaining required records, documentation, and information from members, providers, and partner organizations.
* Connect members with resources addressing social needs, including housing, food, transportation, benefits, behavioral health, and other supportive services.
* Follow established ECM program requirements, documentation standards, workflows, and organizational procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality of member information and comply with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.
* Participate in case coordination, team meetings, audits, quality improvement activities, and other ECM operational activities as needed.
* Provide scheduling and administrative support related to ECM operations and perform other duties related to the position..

**Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Professional and courteous phone etiquette
* Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, and data tracking
* Comfortable with data entry, reporting, and maintaining organized electronic records
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and general computer applications
* Ability to learn and navigate electronic health records (EHR), healthcare portals, and care management systems
* Member outreach, engagement, and follow\-up
* Appointment scheduling and referral coordination
* Accurate and timely documentation and recordkeeping
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple members, tasks, priorities, and deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Problem\-solving skills and ability to follow established procedures
* Ability to communicate professionally with members, healthcare providers, health plans, and community partners
* Understanding of HIPAA, confidentiality, and handling sensitive information
* Dependable, professional, and able to work independently and as part of a team
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred

Pay: $25\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Work Case Manager
jobs.description:
Home \& Health Care Management is the oldest home health care agency in Northern California. Our agency specializes in delivering comprehensive in\-home care and case management for older adults, children, and those living with disabilities across many counties. We use a matrix of Medi\-Cal, Medicare and targeted health programs to find solutions that work for our clients.

 **Overview of the Role**



We want to hire bachelor’s prepared Social Workers (or another related field such as Gerontology) who will work with a Care Management Team (CMT) consisting of Master’s or Bachelor’s prepared Social Worker and Registered Nurse team to provide comprehensive case management services to target population.

 **Who You Are:**



You are a Master's or Bachelor’s Prepared Social Worker (BSW) passionate about making a difference in the lives of individuals.



You are detail oriented, computer literate, and want to work as part of a management team supervising the care of clients who are receiving home and community\-based services.



You are good at problem solving, knowledgeable about community resources, and enjoy helping clients solve social determinants of health care problems.



You want a workplace that values the significant differences Social Workers can make to the health and welfare of clients.



You like working 8am\-5pm on weekdays with no weekend work.

 **Responsibilities:**


* Assists the team with finding community resources (i.e., housing; medical equipment and supplies; primary care physician and specialists; essential items like food, clothing, and household goods; medical transportation; and caregivers, etc.) needed to meet the participant’s needs.
* Engages in advocacy efforts to ensure participants receive timely medical services to remain safe in the community
* Responds timely to questions and enquiries from CMT, participants, and other entities for smooth patient care coordination
* Provides education to participants so they can better understand the benefits of services and community supports.
* Assists participants with applications (i.e., Medi\-Cal; IHSS; Calfresh; and Regional Center, etc.). Explains eligibility requirements, coordinates transportation for participants and other basic needs of support
* Document all consumer interaction and maintain timely reporting and documentation requirements
* Observes participants behavior; reports significant changes to supervisor or team; documents appropriately
* Daily case conference with CMT about shared participants
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

  


**Essential Requirements:**


* Master's degree or Bachelor’s degree in Social Work or another related field
* Skilled in operating a personal computer utilizing a variety of standard software
* Valid California Driver’s License and eligible to be insured under our liability policy with a clean DMV report
* Your own vehicle and proof of current auto insurance
* CPR certificate required within 30 days of hire

  


**Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Certifications**


* Knowledge of basic problems and needs of people diagnosed with a physical disability or emotional disturbance
* Knowledge of community and supportive services
* Skilled in assessing and prioritizing multiple tasks, projects, and demands
* Skilled in working within deadlines to complete projects and assignments
* Skilled in establishing and maintaining effective working relations with co\-workers and other community providers
* Experience with electronic medical records

  


**Location and Service Region:**



This is not a remote role, and you are required to work from our Sacramento office.



You will need your own car and be able to travel to client’s homes in Sacramento County and the greater surrounding area. Work is performed in a community and office environment.



PPE is provided to all employees.



Transporting clients with personal vehicle is prohibited

  


**Schedule**:

  

Full time, 40 hours per week, from Monday through Friday from 8am to 5pm with an hour for lunch. No weekend work.

  

Currently 20% of the time is related to direct home visits, 80% of the time is telehealth video visits and or calls and documentation in the office.

  


**Physical Requirements:**



Job offer is conditional upon successfully passing a medical exam that tests amongst other things the ability to move, visual acuity, and hearing acuity. Physical requirement for this role specifically includes


* Sits, stands, bends, lifts, walks, and moves intermittently during working hours
* Able to lift to 35 pounds without assistance
* Able to drive intermittently

  


**Compensation:**



Pay range is $26\.00 \- $33\.00 / hour. Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience.

  

We value our employees and are proud to offer competitive compensation and benefits package, which may include:


* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance
* Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* FSA (Medical and Dependent Care)
* Aflac
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Leave \& Holidays)
* Monthly phone Stipend
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Mileage Reimbursement (For Eligible Positions)
* Company Vehicles Available (For Eligible Positions)

  


**Apply**

  

If you have an interest in joining our amazing team, we would like to hear from you!

  



Click here to apply online.

  



You can also download the application packet located at www.homeandhealthcaremgmt.com and fax completed applications to 530\-487\-8585 or mail to us at 1398 Ridgewood Dr., Chico, CA 95973, Attention: HR Department.

jobs.description:

Periodic travel of up to 25% is required. Worksite locations are distributed across the western United States, including Hawaii and Alaska. Candidates must be geographically located within reasonable proximity of West Coast states in order to support operations and facilitate fieldwork.

**Duties include**

* Provide comprehensive coordination of logistics, staffing, reporting, and deliverables across multiple active sites.
* Oversee project managers, including cost estimates, work schedules, and staff assignments to maintain on\-time and on\-budget performance.
* Provide oversight to field staff and subcontractors conducting site investigation and remediation projects for approximately 15 field sites located in the West region.
* Ensure that project deliverables, milestones, and budgets are met.
* Work closely with senior managers in the coordination of work activities to meet milestones, budgetary limits, deadlines, or other performance indicators.
* Communicate professionally and effectively with government customers and project partners.
* Prepare, review, and submit well\-written technical reports in accordance with regulations, applicable guidance and policies, and internal quality control standards.
* Conduct Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs).
* Lead field activities, including soil, groundwater, sediment, and soil gas sample collection; geological logging and interpretation; and oversight of investigation and remediation subcontractors, including laboratories and excavation and drilling companies
* Support providing soil and groundwater assessments, soil gas sampling, asbestos inspections, lead\-based paint assessments, geophysical surveys, and waste determinations
* Prepare technical reports and other documents on topics associated with site characterization, remedial optimization, and remedy implementation
* Recognize technical discrepancies in analytical results and making appropriate corrections following standard procedures
* Provide support in organizing public meetings to address the findings of ESAs

**Required Education/Experience**


BS degree in Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science, or related field with four years of practical experience related to environmental field sampling and two years as a field\-team lead. Preferred work experience with contaminated site characterization and remediation at contaminated sites, including Superfund, Brownfields, or RCRA Corrective Action sites. Strong knowledge of federal and state environmental laws and regulations under Federal (e.g., Superfund, RCRA, Brownfields), state, or other cleanup programs. Experience with Phase I and Phase II ESAs and experience conducting quantitative analyses using Microsoft Excel

**REQUIRED CREDENTIALS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER

* Demonstrated attributes to become a strong consultant team player, eagerness to learn and grow, self\-starter who takes the initiative, versatile, and service\-oriented
* Effective written/verbal communication and organization/analytical skills; experience writing and compiling technical data and reports
* Ability to multitask, maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently with minimal supervision

Qualified applicants should include their resume with their completed application for further consideration.

San Diego Aesthetics takes a refined, results\-driven approach to aesthetic medicine — we believe in natural, undetectable enhancement that helps patients feel like the most confident version of themselves, never a different one. The Patient Care Coordinator is the first voice and face our patients experience — and often the last impression they leave with. We're looking for someone genuinely Type A — organized, detail\-obsessed, and calm under a full schedule — who takes pride in running a tight, efficient front office without ever losing the personal touch that makes patients feel taken care of.

* You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in a medical office, medical spa, or medical aesthetic practice — you understand patient care in a clinical setting, not just retail customer service.

* You have polished phone etiquette and know how to manage a multi\-line phone system while attending to patients in front of you.
* You understand the importance of patient confidentiality and are comfortable following HIPAA guidelines when handling medical intake, consents, and records.
* You're comfortable processing payments, deposits, and point\-of\-sale transactions, and you're not afraid to speak to add\-on services, packages, or memberships when it's a genuine fit for the patient.
* You manage competing priorities — the phone, the front desk, and a patient standing in front of you — without dropping the ball on any of them.
* You're time\-efficient and move with urgency, without ever making a patient feel rushed.
* You're tech\-savvy and pick up scheduling/EMR software quickly
* You're open to being part of our social media content and representing SDA on camera when needed.
* You're available to work Sundays.
* Bonus: familiarity with aesthetic treatments, injectables, or the med spa industry.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Scheduling \& Appointment Flow*

* Manage the daily patient schedule to keep the clinic running on time.
* Maintain and work the waitlist, filling openings and handling reschedules proactively.
* Enforce booking fees and cancellation policies consistently and professionally.

*Patient Care Coordination*

* Serve as the primary point of contact for patients before, during, and after their visits, by phone, email, and in person.
* Walk patients through consent forms, treatment policies, and pre/post\-care instructions clearly and accurately, while maintaining HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at every step.
* Anticipate what a patient needs before they have to ask — from treatment questions to logistics.

*Front Office, Payments \& Sales*

* Process payments, deposits, POS transactions, and cancellations with precision — no dropped details.
* Maintain accurate, organized patient records and consent documentation.
* Confidently present and close on packages, memberships, and add\-on services when appropriate for the patient.
* Keep the front office clean, welcoming, and running like a well\-oiled machine.
* Respond to patient inquiries across phone, email, and social/DMs in a timely, professional manner.

*Team \& Brand Contribution*

* Work closely with the clinical team to keep the patient experience seamless from check\-in to check\-out.
* Flag and help solve operational hiccups before they become patient\-facing problems.
* Participate in occasional social content and team content days.

**PERKS \& BENEFITS**

* A role at a highly respected, in\-demand aesthetics practice.
* Room to grow — ongoing education and opportunities for advancement within SDA.
* A tight\-knit, high\-standards team environment.
* Employee pricing and complimentary staff treatments on select SDA services.
* Health insurance and 401(k) are available to full\-time team members.

**WHY SDA?**

We built San Diego Aesthetics around precision, natural results, and an elevated patient experience — and that standard applies to how we run our front office, too. If you're the person who color\-codes your calendar, never lets a follow\-up slip, and genuinely loves being the one who keeps everything (and everyone) on track, we want to talk to you.
